6496923.beer_description: An Altbier made after the classic Dusseldorf style using only the best Voyager Malts and cold conditioned to perfection.

6525921.beer_description:
Dank IPA | 6.2%

We went fishing off the West Coast for a big IPA and pulled in two monster beers. This one we have coated with a thick layer of pineapple express. Crack it fresh to taste the West Coast.

6500063.beer_description: A thoughtful collaboration celebrating life under canvas, campfire yarns and starry nights. With caramel tones, smooth malt and citrus hops, this highland ale is the perfect brew for any camping moment.

6256320.beer_description: Collaboration between Molly Rose and Marrionette, a green walnut sour stout.

4836154.beer_description:
People make fun of stouts too much.
This one might be short and stout but it's bloody tasty and very easy to drink.
Give stouts a break!

3811788.beer_description: This classic West Coast IPA shrines with bright citrus and stone fruit hop aromas and finishes with a dry, clean bitterness.

1681781.beer_description: This American style IPA is layered with a range of mandarin flavour from a carefully selected hop bill and a healthy serving of cold pressed mandarins blended with orange peel liqueur. The result is a super drinkable, fruit drivien IPA with an assertive mandarin peel bitterness and a dry mouthfeel. The perfect Winter IPA making use of our favourite seasonal citrus fruit.

5520651.beer_description: Clarence Hazy Pale Ale is an easy drinking hazy pale ale. Embracing the obsession with opacity, low bitterness and obscene levels of dry hopping as well as some new technology in the form of Subzero HopKief™ - Clarence combines a full pillowy mouthfeel with an array of fruity hop profiles to bring you a truly modern drinking experience. Pair with your favourite naan pocket for a good time.

734257.beer_description: Fat Nerd Vanilla Porter is a smooth & creamy dark beer brewed with loads of vanilla beans, giving it a big vanilla aroma and sweetness which is backed by a lovely chocolate & roasted malt character and a firm bitterness to finish. A great desert beer or one for any sweet tooth!

5441228.beer_description: Kuro Black Rice Lager is a clean, easy drinking dark lager. Using the same base as our Kingu Rice Lager blended with the rich aroma and flavour of darker malts. The darker flavours are derived from roasted malt while still maintaining the crispness of rice to maintain that super smooth finish. Brewed with premier malts, the finest NZ hops and locally sourced rice, the Kuro goes down super smooth with a sweet, rounder fullness and distinct coffee and chocolate flavours. Pairs well with Kuromame

684769.beer_description: Norman Australian Ale is an approachable session beer made from all local ingredients. A light malt base makes way for an abundance of hop character; showcasing vibrant citrus aromas and hints of apple and pear on the palate before finishing with a crisp, clean bitterness leaving you wanting more. Australian hops Galaxy and Ella shine in this quencher, pairing nicely with our locally sourced malt to create a uniquely Australian Ale.

1336924.beer_description: Seabass Mediterranean Lager is a light, dry and clean unfiltered lager. Pouring a pale straw colour, the beer presents subtle spicy & floral flavours from NZ Motueka hops, supported by all Australian barley & wheat. Seabass is the ultimate refresher for any occasion, and is best served with most foods but supports light citrus flavours, salty cheeses and fried foods particularly well.

846928.beer_description: Brewed with a combination of 5 carefully selected malts and 3 pungent US & AUS hop varieties, Slick Rick presents a deep amber/red colour, showing rich caramel malt flavours with a hint of roast and chocolate. This complex malt bill is backed by a solid whack of bitterness from Australian Vic Secret hops, whilst breathing aromas of fruit salad and pineapple from US hops Amarillo & Chinook. The mouthfeel is big, yet surprisingly dry.

458300.beer_description:
KAIJU! BEER: Double IPA was our first beer and it’s an ultra-hopped 9.1% alcohol mind-blower that really lives up to it’s name with enough malt backbone to smooth out the assertive bitterness. 

Moments after the demise of the DiatamaticHopzilla, our heroes tap the bitter mystery fuelling its fury.

4498040.beer_description: Barrel aged stout. Great peril awaits you beyond the Black River.

6501745.beer_description: Introducing Cherry Mary-Jane in her explosive debut, Cherry BOMG (Beaker Oh My God). She’s bringing a heavy hit of dank, weed-like terpenes and a massive payload of cherry aroma. It’s a serious pucker-fest - properly sour and unapologetically red. She’s wandering the galaxy looking for love and we think Blueberry Jerry might just be her soulmate. Will they meet? Who knows. But until then, she’s here to blow your mind.

6676936.beer_name: Clovey With A Chance of Banana

251368.beer_description: Golden Axe is delicious hand crafted apple cider. A fresh tasting, thirst quenching drop with just enough sweetness.

1843438.beer_description:
A super-clean malt profile allows the shipload of juicy tropical fruit flavours to arrive on the desert island of your palate unhindered. And it comes in a can, so after you Krush it, you can Krush it.

After generations of KAIJU! interacting with the local flora, a new species arose. The FRUJUS found the balmy weather and laid-back pace in tropical climes to their liking, settling many remote islands, but always on guard for those who would seek to exploit their mouthwatering juiciness and impeccable balance.

6623400.beer_description:
This is a New Zealand–style Hoppy Pilsner designed to farewell the warmer weather and usher in a new hop-focused season. Built around a powerhouse trio of Riwaka, Motueka and Nelson Sauvin hops. Delivering bright aromatics, high-oil intensity and a crisp, confident structure. Classic pilsner drinkability with a modern, expressive twist.

Think: fresh growth, new beginnings and serious drinking appeal

596462.beer_description: A hop-forward profile with aromas of citrus, tropical fruit, and resin, balanced by a clean malt base and refreshing hop bitterness.

4708166.beer_description:
Presents a hazy light straw colour with aromas of grapefruit, lemon zest, pineapple, and lychee. The palate is clean with a slight lingering bitterness and resin character and is impeccably balanced.

Brewed with: 
Rolled Oats
Rolled Wheat
Chit Malt (baby malt)
 
Whirlpool hopped with  
Amarillo
Citra 
Mosaic
 
Dry-hopped with:
Citra Mosaic 
Nelson Sauvin, 
Eldorado,Galaxy

5405641.beer_description: Enjoy our brand new Banoffee Pie-PA. A thick velvety IPA with notes of toffee, cream and hints of banana. If you have a sweet tooth this is the treat for you.

768311.beer_description: Our Belgian-style IPA, brewed with Saison yeast to give the beer a pepper-like clove aroma. Smooth, malty & mild this is the IPA for IPA lovers and non-lovers alike.

4376766.beer_description: A Black Forest what? Gateau of where? Have your cake and drink it too. Our Black Forest Gateau is loaded with rich chocolate malts, cherries, vanilla and lactose. It's liquid cake! Keep it cold. Drink it fresh!

2799980.beer_description: Dad & Dave’s Citra & Mosaic IPA is double dry hopped, delivering a well-balanced malty-sweet, tropical aroma and guava flavour. Deceptively smooth to drink.

5903878.beer_description:
Crusher Hard Cherry Cola, the blast from the past with a cherry twist!

Unleash the power of cherry and cola and let the crusher take over.

It's not just a drink, it's a lifestyle. Drink responsibly or not at all.

5903877.beer_description:
Crusher Hard Ginger Beer is a bold choice for those who dare.

It's robust ginger flavour delivers a fiery blend of sweetness and spice, perfect for quenching a mighty thirst.

It's a beverage that's as fearless as y0u are.

1280946.beer_description: This pilsner has a fantastic crisp malt body, and an herbaceous lingering yet light bitterness, making it the perfect session beer for those warm afternoons.

6699565.beer_description:
Pouring a vibrant pink, this refreshing sour showcases the bright tropical character of dragonfruit. Subtle sweetness and juicy fruit notes are balanced by a lively acidity that keeps the beer crisp and refreshing.
Light-bodied and vibrant, it’s a colourful, fruit-forward sour with a clean, tangy finish.

3695003.beer_description: Limited release. This dragon fruit sour has a deep pink-red pour with a creamy slightly pink head. Expect mild tartness with flavours of dragonfruit and something similar to berry aroma.

6699563.beer_description:
Pouring a vibrant pink, this refreshing sour showcases the bright tropical character of dragonfruit. Subtle sweetness and juicy fruit notes are balanced by a lively acidity that keeps the beer crisp and refreshing.
Light-bodied and vibrant, it’s a colourful, fruit-forward sour with a clean, tangy finish.

6621197.beer_description: Crafted with over 90kg of real blueberries, this special edition fruited lager delivers vibrant berry aromatics, a subtle natural sweetness and a gentle tart lift. The clean, crisp lager base keeps it bright and refreshing, allowing the fruit to shine while finishing dry and dangerously easy to drink.

6581340.beer_description: This Japanese Rice Lager is light, crisp, and quietly complex. Flaked rice keeps the body refreshing, while a touch of kombu brings gentle umami and savoury depth.
